description.en: Let DSH agents explore, build, and chat on Minecraft servers through native game tools.
DeepSeek Harness plugin: image + video generation studio with an infinite canvas. Fork of dickpy/dsh-imagegen with a complete video pipeline and clip stitching.
description.zh: untranslated

description.en: DSH 视频皮肤：聊天背景 + 有声开机动画 + 界面内透明度调节
description.zh: untranslated

description.en: Markdown rendering for DeepSeek Harness sent messages: the user and steering chat bubbles render headings, lists, code, tables, math and quotes through the host's own Markdown pipeline, while reference chips, attachments and the action strip stay intact.
Mobile device capability plugin for DeepSeek Harness: MobileService seam, mock/mobile-mcp providers, agent tools (observe/open_app/tap/type/back), tiered execution policy

Installable wrapper for the DSH plugin in dsh-kdczyz-mode/: WorkBuddy model pool + Trae connector + Qoder account pool as three independent providers, plus one settings page with six tabs (XD Pool / Trae config [provider switch, account binding, model sel
让 AI 直接「读蓝湖（Lanhu）设计稿」—— 把设计稿解析成可直抄的精确数值（色值 / 字号 / 圆角 / 间距 / 文本），替代靠截图估算。
Sweeps AI byproducts (scratch files, backups, logs, caches) into a reversible trash per project, and on project close classifies deliverables, archives reference results and writes a cleanup report.
description.zh: 把 AI 会话留下的草稿、备份、日志、缓存收进可逆回收站；项目结项时归类成品、归档可引用结果并生成结项清理清单，未结项期间一切保留。

description.en: Let Codex dispatch tasks to DeepSeek Harness workspaces, follow execution, read results, and continue collaboration through a local bridge and companion Codex skill.
description.zh: 通过本机桥接插件与配套 Codex 技能，让 Codex 向 DeepSeek Harness 工作区派发任务、跟踪执行、回读结果并继续协作。

description.en: Opens academic sites through institutional proxy rules and optionally renames eligible new PDFs using matched article metadata, with Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and US English settings.
description.zh: 按机构代理规则打开学术网站，可依据匹配的论文元数据重命名符合条件的新 PDF，并提供简体中文、繁体中文及美式英语设置界面。

description.en: A Windows floating desktop pet with task notifications, native session controls and continuous local voice calls using the configured local recognizer and Windows system speech.
description.zh: Windows 悬浮桌面宠物，提供任务通知、原生会话控制及使用已配置本地识别器和 Windows 系统语音的连续本地通话。

description.en: Windows toast notifications for DeepSeek Harness covering approval requests, questions, run completion, errors and sign-in prompts, with the conversation name as the first line of every notification.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows 桌面通知：申请权限、提问、任务完成、出错与登录提醒，每条通知第一行都是会话名称。

description.en: Branch and worktree management for DeepSeek Harness: the workspace toolbar shows the current branch with in-place switching, plus an IDEA-style branch selector, remote branch checkout, context menus (create, rename, delete, copy), push and update, and branch isolation into standalone worktrees with managed creation and deletion.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 git 分支与 worktree 管理：工作区工具栏显示当前分支并可原地切换；支持 IDEA 风格分支选择器、远程分支检出、右键操作菜单（新建/重命名/删除/复制）、推送与更新当前分支，以及把分支隔离到独立 worktree 工作区并管理其创建与删除。

description.en: Git repository connector for DeepSeek Harness: saved repo profiles addressed by name, work-copy operations (clone/fetch/pull/push/commit), Gitea/Forgejo/GitHub API tools, keys in the DSH credential center, and per-repo safety flags (TLS bypass, overwrite, force push).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Git 仓库连接：按档案名操作仓库（clone/fetch/pull/push/commit）、Gitea/Forgejo/GitHub API、密钥存 DSH 凭据中心，并按仓库单独授权忽略证书/允许覆盖/force push 等危险开关。

description.en: Re-encodes WebP attachment images to PNG so alpha-channel images load on LLM backends that cannot decode WebP (e.g. llama.cpp).
description.zh: 把 WebP 附件图片转码成 PNG，让带 alpha 通道的图能在无法解码 WebP 的 LLM 后端上加载（例如 llama.cpp）。

description.en: Optional JEV decision mode with deterministic project reads, bounded semantic selection, native authorization checks and desktop credential settings.
description.zh: 可选 JEV 决策模式，提供代码优先项目读取、有限语义选择、原生授权检查与桌面密钥设置。

description.en: Multiple named launch targets in the DSH composer: left-click starts the default target, right-click opens the list.
description.zh: 对话输入框的多启动项按钮：左键启动默认项，右键弹出列表，每项可绑定一个程序或目录。

description.en: Copying rendered math from the chat puts the formula's LaTeX source on the clipboard instead of KaTeX's visual glyph text.
description.zh: 在对话中复制渲染后的数学公式时，剪贴板里得到的是公式的 LaTeX 源码，而不是 KaTeX 的字形文本。

description.en: Gives DSH the full 33-tool browser surface (ctx.browser seam -> a self-hosted headless moli browser over CDP: one 127.0.0.1 daemon with Bearer-token auth, request-path whitelist and WebSocket rewriting, no root/GUI/Electron needed; single-engine moli serve with auto LD_LIBRARY_PATH/FONTCONFIG_FILE injection and a persistent profile dir for logins), plus a web panel — a real page you can click, scroll and type in, operation/console/network logs with one-click cleanup, a customizable window (border color, transparency, glass, fit-to-picture with no black bars, top-inset and self-centering) and an adjustable page size (1920x1080 by default) — plus a collapsed pill that can be dragged to any spot on the screen (free position), a live view that auto-resumes when you switch back to the web tab, and a 1920px default max edge for the live frame — and two bundled skills (browser, browser-runtime) served through the plugin built-in skill provider, so the skill centre lists them as system-level by default without writing into $DSH_HOME/skills.
description.zh: 为 DSH 挂出完整的浏览器工具面（33 个 browser_* 工具）：把 ctx.browser 接缝接到自管的 moli 无头浏览器（经 127.0.0.1 单例 CDP 守护进程，带 Bearer token 鉴权、请求路径白名单与 WebSocket 地址改写，不需要 root / GUI 库 / Electron；单发动机 moli serve 直连，自动注入 LD_LIBRARY_PATH 与 FONTCONFIG_FILE，profile 目录持久化登录态）；另带一个网页面板——可直接点、滚、打字的实时页面，操作/控制台/网络日志与一键清理，窗口外观（边框色、透明度、玻璃效果）与几何（贴合画面比例去黑边、顶部留白、默认居中）可自定义，页面分辨率可调（默认 1920×1080）——收起后的胶囊可拖到任意位置（自由位置），切回「网页」自动续帧不用再点「开始」，实时画面「最大边」默认 1920——外加两份随包技能（browser、browser-runtime），由插件经 DSH 内置技能提供者提供，技能中心显示「系统内置」，默认不往 $DSH_HOME/skills 落盘。

description.en: Gated four-stage video pipeline: brief, script, assets and compose, turning one sentence into a narrated explainer with ComfyUI workflows or image/video APIs and FFmpeg assembly.
description.zh: 四段带审批闸的视频创作管线：立项、脚本、素材、合成，把一句话变成带配音、配图或视频和字幕的解说片；生成走 ComfyUI 工作流或图片/视频 API，合成走 FFmpeg。

description.en: A fork of zhu1090093659/dsh-pet (Apache-2.0), adding per-conversation companions with whale-girl, MIKU and business blue whale skins, model-themed colors, token-rate animation, completion reminders and shared feeding and affinity.
description.zh: 基于 zhu1090093659/dsh-pet（Apache-2.0）改造，新增每个活跃会话一只桌宠，提供鲸鱼娘、MIKU 与商务小蓝鲸皮肤、模型配色、随生成速度跑动、完成待查看提醒、共享喂食与亲密度。

description.en: Adds /btw and /side slash commands that answer ephemeral side questions in an isolated forked sub-session without polluting the main conversation context.
description.zh: 新增 /btw 与 /side 斜杠命令，在隔离的分叉子会话中回答临时旁问，不污染主会话上下文。

description.en: Session trash for DSH: move sessions to a recoverable trash, restore or purge them in settings.
description.zh: 会话回收站：移入回收站、恢复或永久删除会话。

description.en: Mount the QianYuan MCP server inside DeepSeek Harness: one config-layer bundle brings 15 agent-record tools (pitfalls, cached results, identity, task board) to mcp__qianyuan__*. No runtime code; reads are anonymous, writes are ed25519-signed.
description.zh: 把乾元 MCP 服务器挂进 DeepSeek Harness：一个纯配置层 bundle 带来 15 个 agent 记录工具（坑库、成果缓存、身份、任务板），注册为 mcp__qianyuan__*。不含运行时代码；读匿名，写用 ed25519 签名。

description.en: Connects QQ Bot private and group chats to DeepSeek Harness Desktop, with per-chat personas, interactive questions, and optional image understanding.
description.zh: 将 QQ 私聊和群聊接入 DeepSeek Harness Desktop，支持按会话切换人格、交互式提问和可选图片理解。

description.en: Minecraft redstone music: rm_render renders instrument samples from a SoundFont and aligns every onset to within 3 ms, and rm_build compiles a song plus lane table into a datapack of scheduled mcfunction shards (optionally deployed over RCON).
description.zh: Minecraft 红石音乐：rm_render 从 SoundFont 渲染乐器采样并把起音对齐到 3ms 内，rm_build 把谱面与轨表编译成分片 mcfunction 数据包（可选经 RCON 部署开建）。

description.en: Adds Copy session ID and permanent deletion of a Conversation's log, projection cache and workspace references to the session row's ⋯ menu, behind a two-step confirm.
description.zh: 在会话行的「⋯」菜单里补上复制会话 ID，以及永久删除会话（日志、投影缓存与工作区引用），删除前有二次确认。

description.en: Reports each machine's token usage to a team server you host, with one-time enrollment codes, an offline disk queue, and idempotent replay, so an administrator can see every member's usage and cost in one place.
description.zh: 把每台机器的 token 用量上报给你自己托管的团队服务器：一次性绑定码、离线落盘队列、幂等重放，管理员在一处看到全员用量与成本。

description.en: A Herta theme for DeepSeek Harness: an ASCII boot opening ported from the upstream Herta project, a violet palette of design tokens, swappable wallpapers (four bundled, plus image URL, local import, solid colour or off) and a "Herta Appearance" page in DSH settings. Doubles as the theme that dsh-herta ships with.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的黑塔主题：移植自上游 Herta 项目的开机 ASCII 开场、一整套紫罗兰设计令牌、可替换的壁纸（自带四张，也支持图片网址 / 本机导入 / 纯色 / 关掉），以及 DSH 设置里的「黑塔外观」页。它同时就是 dsh-herta 自带的那套主题。

description.en: Injects the exact current local time and the timestamp, day relation and recency gap of the previous user message into every prompt, and adds a /time command that prints the injected block.
description.zh: 为每次请求注入精确的本地当前时间，以及上一条用户消息的时间、日期关系与间隔；并提供 /time 命令查看注入内容。

description.en: Vietnamese UI language for the DSH web client (all 2,615 core strings), three Vietnamese palettes in light and dark, and a rotating Vietnam-landscape backdrop from Wikimedia Commons with per-photo attribution.
description.zh: DSH 网页客户端的越南语界面（全部 2,615 条核心文案）、浅色与深色各三套越南风配色，以及来自 Wikimedia Commons 的越南风景轮播背景（逐张标注作者与许可）。

description.en: A fake-ip-aware ctx.web fetch provider that takes over the stock http provider id: a hostname is accepted when every DNS answer is a placeholder inside the proxy's fake-ip block (198.18.0.0/15 by default), so web_fetch works under mihomo/Clash TUN mode without disabling fake-ip or setting proxy environment variables. IP literals and private, loopback and reserved destinations stay blocked.
description.zh: ctx.web 的 fake-ip 感知抓取后端，接管官方 http provider id：当某主机名的每一条 DNS 应答都是代理 fake-ip 段（默认 198.18.0.0/15）内的占位地址时予以接受，从而在 mihomo/Clash TUN 模式下无需关闭 fake-ip、也无需设置代理环境变量即可使用 web_fetch；IP 字面量与私有、回环、保留地址仍被拒绝。

description.en: Deep-sea whale-blue reskin for the DSH Web GUI: 14 theme tokens in light and dark, five whale-tail-maid placements, a clock and weather card, and a collapsible hardware readout (CPU, memory, GPU, per-drive temperatures via HWiNFO). No backdrop image is bundled; drop your own in. MIT code, MIT character art.
description.zh: 给 DSH Web GUI 的深海鲸蓝换肤：亮/暗两套共 14 个主题 token、5 处鲸尾女仆角色元素、时钟与天气卡片，以及可上下伸缩的硬件状态悬浮窗（CPU / 内存 / GPU / 硬盘温度，温度需 HWiNFO 提供）。包内不含背景图，放一张你自己的即可。源码与角色素材均为 MIT。

description.en: Reuses the local model proxy of a logged-in XiaoyiWork desktop app (Windows only) so its models appear in DeepSeek Harness without a separate API key.
description.zh: 复用已登录的小艺Work 桌面端本地模型代理（仅限 Windows），其模型直接出现在 DeepSeek Harness 中，无需单独 API Key。

description.en: Trip-planning agent preset for mainland China that answers in Chinese: queries 12306 train availability, Fliggy and Tuniu flight and hotel prices, and real Amap transit routes, checks closures and weather, and delivers a single offline HTML roadbook with draggable maps, three hotel price tiers and an itemized budget. Ships 9 skills, an environment doctor that walks users through missing API keys, and a patch for the 12306 MCP server; it plans and queries but never books or pays.
description.zh: 中文旅行规划 agent 预设「旅行规划助手」（面向国内行程）：实时查 12306 余票、飞猪 / 途牛机票与酒店价格、高德真实路线，核实闭馆与天气，交付一份可离线打开的单文件 HTML 路书（可拖动地图、三档酒店、分项预算）；附 9 个技能、引导用户补齐 Key 的环境自检，以及 12306 MCP 的预售期补丁；只规划查询，不代订代付。
